_readme: THEME FILE — colours, fonts and logo for the whole website. Change a colour code here and every page updates. For Nile International School, copy this project and edit only this file, site.config.mjs, the 'brand' folder and the 'content' folder.

logo._readme: The crest in brand/logo.png is used automatically. The words below are shown next to it in the header and footer (and on their own if no logo file exists).

colors._readme: Navy and gold sampled from the school crest (brand/logo.png).

fonts._readme: Heading = elegant serif; Body = clean sans-serif. The Arabic fonts are already loaded and used automatically for Arabic text.
fonts.heading: Playfair Display Variable
